title: Sports Notice "All Pakistan Inter-University Table Tennis and Badminton (Men) Championship"
text:
🏓🏸 Sports Notice

It is hereby notified that the
All Pakistan Inter-University Table Tennis and Badminton (Men) Championship

is scheduled to be held in
October 2025
.

All interested male players from
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
and its affiliated colleges
are required to
register themselves on 6th October 2025 at 10:00 AM
at the

Directorate of Sports Office
.

📍
Directorate of Sports
, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (Garden Campus)

📞
0314-9215608

Directorate of Sports, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
